title: Electrical Program Lead Engineer
jobDescription:
The group you’ll be a part of:

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's WETS products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry

Primary RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Executes Electrical Engineering technical assignments, projects with primary focus on designing, developing, modifying Power distribution and Control Panels.
  • Understands the customer requirements, leads the concept development, prepares detailed schematic design, builds the product, and leads the validation of Power distribution and Control Panels.
  • Selects electrical OEM components (Circuit Breakers, Contactors, Relays, terminal blocks, cables, busbars, connectors, etc.) and materials for Power distribution / control panel design.
  • Creates electrical schematics for power boxes and system interconnects based on requirements received from cross-disciplinary teams.
  • Works closely with Cross functional team including Mechanical Engineering, Supply chain, Test Lab, Program Management and global stakeholders while delivering assignments and projects.
  • Creates and releases engineering drawings & bill of materials using Engineering Change Management process.
  • Provides corrective solutions for Problem Reports of varying complexities on power boxes from suppliers and customers.
  • Provides immediate response and timely resolution to design related production issues encountered during the product build process.
  • Works in a very dynamic and fast paced work environment by providing custom design solutions for non-standard customer requirements having frequent design updates.
  • Conducts gating design reviews to get alignment on design package from cross functional leaders.
  • Experience in setting up equipment for experimentation / testing in laboratory environment, setting up safe practices.

Mandatory Skills:

  • Proven hands-on experience on power boxes & control boxes in gathering requirements, designing, testing and implementing to high volume manufacturing.
  • Proficiency in assessing loading, performing SCCR calculations, thermal calculations, wire sizing, busbar designs, switchgear selection, etc. for power boxes and panels
  • Proficiency in handling multiple configurations, logic for EMO, LOTO Concept, multiple power inputs and outputs.
  • Hands on experience in creation of electrical schematic diagram, control panel facility connections & field disconnects.
  • Must have worked on electrical engineering CAD tools like E3 ZUKEN or equivalent CAD packages for circuit design & simulation, form board flattening for EE documentation.
  • Experience with executing & reviewing FMEA, structured Investigation, Problem Solving & Decision Making.
  • Good understanding of different standards and compliances like – NEC, NFPA 79, UL 508A, IEC standard
  • Proven leadership & mentoring skills.

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master’s in Electrical Engineering with 10 years of relevant experience or
  • Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering 12 years of relevant experience

Desirable Skills:

  • Being well versed with Part life cycle management, Obsolescence management activities.
  • SEMI Standards knowledge - S2, S8, S22 etc.
  • Exposure to DFX for Power Boxes/panels
  • Basic Knowledge for electronic circuits, PCBs is a value addition.
  • Controls and logics (IO controls) – Design & development and troubleshooting
  • Communication protocols knowledge and troubleshooting with software interfaces

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

title: Electrical Technical Lead Engineer
jobDescription:
The Group You'll Be A Part Of

WETS Deposition group at Lam India Global Hardware Technology (LIGHT) is hiring a Electrical Lead Engineer for its product development engineering and product ownership team.

Job Summary

As an Electrical Lead Engineer, you will lead the design and delivery of electrical and electro‑mechanical subsystems for wafer fabrication equipment, with a primary focus on fluid delivery systems and process modules for WETS Deposition products. The role provides technical leadership across system architecture, electrical integration, and cross‑functional collaboration to deliver robust, manufacturable, and serviceable solutions.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop Functional Requirement Specifications for various Electro-Mechanical systems.
  • Selection of Electrical & Electronics OEM components and materials for Power distribution, I/O Controllers, Sensors, Cables, PCBs etc.
  • Create and Release system level Electrical engineering drawings & bill of materials using Engineering Change Management process.
  • Work on Electrical/Electronic engineering CAD tools for circuit design & simulations.
  • Perform various circuit analyses like De-rating & Stress analysis, Power analysis & Logic compatibility analysis etc.
  • Define project schedule, work breakdown structure and milestones to drive concept to production lifecycle.
  • Study and recommend corrective/ permanent solutions for technical challenges/new products.
  • Define test procedures, and participate in assembly, build and test verification
  • Well versed with Part life cycle management, Obsolescence management activities.
  • Conduct and drive Design reviews to get buy-in from all cross functional teams.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior engineers.

Minimum Qualifications

  • EDUCATION: B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech in Electrical Engineering
  • Experience: Bachelors in Electrical/Electronics Engineering with a minimum 8 exp. or Masters in Electrical Engineering with a minimum 6 Yrs Exp.

Core Competencies

  • Proficient in system level understanding of Electro-Mechanical Sub-systems (Semi-conductor/Automotive/Aerospace), Power Distribution/Control systems and/or Industrial Automation.
  • Proficient in Electrical/Electronic Circuit concept design & development with safety interlocks & various circuit analyses. (Circuit analyses include De-rating & Stress analysis, Power analysis & Logic compatibility analysis etc.)
  • Proficient in selecting Electrical/Electronic OEM components.
  • Expert level knowledge of Engineering change management & problem-solving skills
  • Must have worked on any one of electrical engineering CAD tools like PCAD, ORCAD, ZUKEN, Cadence or equivalent CAD packages for circuit design & simulation.
  • Familiar with standards like - UL 508, IEC 60947, SEMI S22, NFPA79.

Desirable Competencies

  • Experience in Semiconductor Wafer Fab Equipment (WFE) domain.
  • Experience in capital equipment or similar (for e.g., Semiconductor, Process industries, medical instrumentation, Automotive, Aerospace, etc.) industry in a sub-system / module design project.
  • Experience in setting up equipment for experimentation / testing in laboratory environment, setting up safe practices.
  • Good Communication skills and able to mentor junior engineers.

title: Mechanical Program Lead Engineer
jobDescription:
The group you’ll be a part of

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.

The impact you’ll make

As a Mechanical Engineer at Lam, you're designing and defining cutting-edge mechanical and electro-mechanical systems. Your role involves feasibility studies, testing, and guiding teams in detailed design and fabrication. You provide the crucial design information needed to shape our technology's packaging.

In this role, you will directly contribute to ___.

What you’ll do

  • Support the full life cycle of mechanical and electro-mechanical systems from concept to productization including conceptualization, designing, CAD modeling, development, and test/validation.
  • Designs components using variety of metals, ceramics, quartz, plastics, and advanced coatings.
  • Ensure documentation aligns with SEMI, Lam standards, and industry best practices for geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T).
  • Conduct detailed analysis including structural, finite element analysis (FEA), thermal, heat transfer, stress, vibrations, fluid and gas flow dynamics, and manufacturability to properly specify designs.
  • Develop and conduct feasibility studies and test plans to characterize and validate design performance.
  • Prepare high-quality reports and technical presentations to clearly communicate design intent, evaluation, and validation to a diverse audience in design reviews.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and internal teams to ensure solutions can be manufactured with high-quality, cost-optimized, and to requirements.
  • Provide key deliverables including Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), technical specifications, risk analysis, test specifications, and design review presentations.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to more junior engineers

Who we’re looking for

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field with 8+ years of experience; or Master’s degree with 6+ years’ experience; or equivalent experience.
  • Excellent communication, both written and verbal, and technical presentation skills.
  • Highly proficient in 3D CAD tools such as CREO, Siemens NX, Pro E, Solid Works, and others.
  • Hands-on experimental and design background coupled with solid engineering skills.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in Semiconductor industry is a plus.
  • Experience in leading projects, or problem solving while managing time and multiple priorities.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

title: Technical Program Manager 4
jobDescription:
The group you’ll be a part of

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.

The impact you’ll make

As a Technical Program Manager at Lam, you are not just overseeing projects – you’re orchestrating breakthroughs in support of Owning the Outcome. You’ll lead cross-functional teams through successful project execution blending your technical excellence with strategic planning to deliver new or upgraded products. Your role is vital, owning technical projects from initiation through delivery using your expertise in planning, directing, and monitoring schedules and budget.

What you’ll do

  • Perform technical program management duties involving cross-functional teams focused on delivery of company’s products and services.
  • Develop and present program plans to senior management, gain buy in and deliver results.
  • Organizes cross-functional activities, ensuring completion of the program i.e. product/ solution release on schedule and within budget constraints.
  • Monitors the program from initiation through delivery including planning and directing schedules and monitoring budget/spending.
  • Manage CFTs with a diverse array of talents and responsibilities to drive to solutions and alignment (with program objective, product release and material cut-in strategies, Excess & Obsolete (E&O) and effectivities)
  • Assist in the definition and institutionalizing of new processes to improve effectiveness, leverage synergies and enable maturity of the organization.
  • Be the change agent, driving process excellence, ownership of PDR process, responsiveness to dynamic business environment and leading by example.

Who we’re looking for

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 12 years of experience; or Master’s degree with 10 years experience;
  • 8+ years of technical program management.
  • Experience guiding cross-functional teams and demonstrating leadership and influence skills to deliver results.
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills with the ability to present to audiences at all levels in the Company.

Preferred qualifications

Mandatory skills

  • Knowledge of Program Management methods and experience in Product Development & Release (PDR) procedures.
  • Strong influencing, negotiating and conflict resolution skills.
  • Experience in or knowledge of Semiconductor fabrication, Semiconductor Equipment Operations, or related industries is a plus.
  • Experience in HW development, Agile and/or Waterfall project methodologies is a plus
  • Expertise with project management software and tools including MS Project, Office Timeline, or equivalent.
  • Structured Thinking: Logical approach, appropriate framing problems, and conclusions. Focuses on building capabilities across span of control.
  • Communication: Clear, concise, and conclusive that shapes senior-leader understanding and draws out specific recommendations and conclusions.
  • People Management: Leads CFTs that continually improves self, business, and function. Sets direction for group and provides compelling vision for the work; establishes a high-performance environment.
  • Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multi-tasking skills.
  • Other experience that would prove highly valuable: Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Operations and Logistics.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

description:
The group you’ll be a part of

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.

The impact you’ll make

As a Technical Program Manager at Lam, you are not just overseeing projects – you’re orchestrating breakthroughs in support of Owning the Outcome. You’ll lead cross-functional teams through successful project execution blending your technical excellence with strategic planning to deliver new or upgraded products. Your role is vital, owning technical projects from initiation through delivery using your expertise in planning, directing, and monitoring schedules and budget.

What you’ll do

  • Perform technical program management duties involving cross-functional teams focused on delivery of company’s products and services.
  • Develop and present program plans to senior management, gain buy in and deliver results.
  • Organizes cross-functional activities, ensuring completion of the program i.e. product/ solution release on schedule and within budget constraints.
  • Monitors the program from initiation through delivery including planning and directing schedules and monitoring budget/spending.
  • Manage CFTs with a diverse array of talents and responsibilities to drive to solutions and alignment (with program objective, product release and material cut-in strategies, Excess & Obsolete (E&O) and effectivities)
  • Assist in the definition and institutionalizing of new processes to improve effectiveness, leverage synergies and enable maturity of the organization.
  • Be the change agent, driving process excellence, ownership of PDR process, responsiveness to dynamic business environment and leading by example.

Who we’re looking for

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 12 years of experience; or Master’s degree with 10 years experience;
  • 8+ years of technical program management.
  • Experience guiding cross-functional teams and demonstrating leadership and influence skills to deliver results.
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills with the ability to present to audiences at all levels in the Company.

Preferred qualifications

Mandatory skills

  • Knowledge of Program Management methods and experience in Product Development & Release (PDR) procedures.
  • Strong influencing, negotiating and conflict resolution skills.
  • Experience in or knowledge of Semiconductor fabrication, Semiconductor Equipment Operations, or related industries is a plus.
  • Experience in HW development, Agile and/or Waterfall project methodologies is a plus
  • Expertise with project management software and tools including MS Project, Office Timeline, or equivalent.
  • Structured Thinking: Logical approach, appropriate framing problems, and conclusions. Focuses on building capabilities across span of control.
  • Communication: Clear, concise, and conclusive that shapes senior-leader understanding and draws out specific recommendations and conclusions.
  • People Management: Leads CFTs that continually improves self, business, and function. Sets direction for group and provides compelling vision for the work; establishes a high-performance environment.
  • Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multi-tasking skills.
  • Other experience that would prove highly valuable: Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Operations and Logistics.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

title: Technical Program Manager, Sr
jobDescription:
The group you’ll be a part of

The Customer Support Business Group focuses on enabling our customers with premier customer support throughout their lifecycle with Lam. We drive performance, productivity, safety, and quality of customers installed base performance and deliver service and lifecycle solutions for their most critical equipment and processes.

The impact you’ll make

As a Technical Program Manager at Lam, you are not just overseeing projects – you’re orchestrating breakthroughs in support of [insert strategic initiative]. You’ll lead cross-functional teams through successful project execution blending your technical excellence with strategic planning to deliver new or upgraded products. Your role is vital, owning technical projects from initiation through delivery using your expertise in planning, directing, and monitoring schedules and budget.

In this role, you will directly contribute to ___.

What you’ll do

Who we’re looking for

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 2+ years of experience; or Master’s degree with no previous professional experience; or equivalent experience.
  • This is a graduate eligible role.

Preferred qualifications

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. The group you’ll be a part of

The Customer Support Business Group focuses on enabling our customers with premier customer support throughout their lifecycle with Lam. We drive performance, productivity, safety, and quality of customers installed base performance and deliver service and lifecycle solutions for their most critical equipment and processes.

The impact you’ll make

As a Technical Program Manager at Lam, you are not just overseeing projects – you’re orchestrating breakthroughs in support of [insert strategic initiative]. You’ll lead cross-functional teams through successful project execution blending your technical excellence with strategic planning to deliver new or upgraded products. Your role is vital, owning technical projects from initiation through delivery using your expertise in planning, directing, and monitoring schedules and budget.

In this role, you will directly contribute to ___.

What you’ll do

Who we’re looking for

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 2+ years of experience; or Master’s degree with no previous professional experience; or equivalent experience.
  • This is a graduate eligible role.

Preferred qualifications

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

At Lam Research, we create equipment that drives technological advancements in the semiconductor industry. Our innovative solutions enable chipmakers to power progress in nearly all aspects of modern life, and it takes each member of our team to make it possible.


Across our organization, our employees come to work and change the world. We take on the toughest challenges with precision and accuracy. We push for the next big semiconductor breakthrough. We lead the way in one of the most critical and fast-moving industries on the planet. And we do it together, with deep connections and limitless collaboration.


The impact we have on the world is made possible by focusing on our people. So we recognize and celebrate our teams’ achievements. We strive to create an inclusive and diverse culture where everyone’s contribution and voice has value. We evaluate and evolve our offerings, so our people receive the support and empowerment to do meaningful things for their lives, careers, and communities.


Because at Lam, we believe that when people are the priority and they’re inspired to unleash the power of innovation for a better world together, anything is possible.

title: Hardware Designer 1
jobDescription:
Position Title: Mechanical Hardware Designer (Level 25E)

Eligibility Criteria:

Bachelor’s in Mechanical Engineering with 1–5 years of experience in mechanical / electromechanical component engineering, design support, or related areas.

The group you’ll be a part of

Component Engineering Group - CEG Co E

Primary RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Create and update 3D CAD models, assemblies, and 2D drawings for mechanical/electromechanical parts.
  • Support design changes by updating CAD data, BOMs, and engineering documentation.
  • Participate in design reviews (PDR/DR) and incorporate feedback
  • Assist in fitment, interference, tolerance, and basic design validation reviews.
  • Maintain accurate part, assembly, and release data in PLM/PDM systems.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to support component release and issue resolution

Mandatory Skills:

Mechanical

  • Working knowledge of NX, Creo, or equivalent CAD tools.
  • Basic knowledge of mechanical/electromechanical commercial off the shelf components
  • Ability to create/update parts, assemblies.
  • Understanding of BOM, CAD release, and engineering change processes.
  • Awareness of Form-Fit-Function (FFF) concepts in component selection
  • Basic understanding of design lifecycle and product development processes
  • Strong attention to detail and learning orientation

Desired Skills:

  • Exposure to PLM/PDM systems such as Teamcenter or Windchill.
  • Awareness of DFM/DFA and common manufacturing processes.
  • Basic knowledge of ISO, DIN, ASME, or SEMI standards.
  • Familiarity with component lifecycle (qualification, obsolescence, alternate sourcing)
  • Exposure to tolerance stack-up, fitment, or design validation activities.
  • Excellent communication, both written and verbal
  • Exposure to cross-functional working environments

Competencies

Communication
Problem Solving
Team Collaboration
Agility
Decision Making
Innovation and Continuous Improvement
Open Communication

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

title: Global Trade Analyst Lead
jobDescription:
The group you’ll be a part of

Lam Research - LIGO (Lam india global Operation)

The impact you’ll make

Ensures legal compliance and provides import/export administration and control within government rules and regulations, including appropriate licensing for shipments. Reviews contracts for required clauses and identifies omissions. Interfaces with internal and external customers, foreign order administration, freight forwarders, customs officers and other functional areas to ensure coordination and logistics of shipment. Selects carrier/forwarder for shipment of products and prepares documents for freight forwarders.

What you’ll do

  • Experience in US Export compliance and Asia Regional compliance
  • Responsibilities include review of parts specifications, bills of materials(BOM), descriptions, and external web sites to categorize Lam Materials into categories that have been previously defined by Global Trade. These categories correspond to tariff classifications in countries where Lam does business
  • Reviewing individual parts & Harmonized Tariff Schedule(HTS) classification for different kind of Mechanical, Electrical and Electronics items (semiconductor Industry)
  • Designating a category to each respective part,
  • Engaging Foreign Trade on periodic review to align on categorizations, and
  • Alerting Foreign Trade of parts that do not conform to any existing designations
  • Foreign Trade will provide initial instruction on job expectations and ongoing feedback on how to interpret the categories for which Lam Materials will be assigned.
  • Import/Export Customs entry audit for all regions(US, Europe, Asia)
  • Knowledge on US Government regulations on all aspects of International Import/Export Trade
  • Knowledge on Free Trade Agreement and validate eligibilities (KORUS, USMCA, AKFTA etc)
  • Knowledge on US FTZ (Free Trade Zone) & Malaysia LMW process(Licensed Manufacturing Warehouse)
  • Sanctioned party screening

Who we’re looking for

  • Years of Experience: Minimum 6 years of Experience

    Job Experience : working Experience in HTS/ECCN Product Classification, GTS release, sanctioned party screening, Export/Import Auditing and global Trade compliance

    Educational: Typically requires a 6-8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and Certification in global trade/Trade Compliance/Logistics

Preferred qualifications

  • Technical knowledge of semiconductor or comparable industries, including familiarity with Bills of Materials
  • Familiarity with reading technical specifications, engineering drawing, datasheets
  • Detailed oriented, strong analytical skills, and agility to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.

description:
The group you’ll be a part of

Lam Research - LIGO (Lam india global Operation)

The impact you’ll make

Ensures legal compliance and provides import/export administration and control within government rules and regulations, including appropriate licensing for shipments. Reviews contracts for required clauses and identifies omissions. Interfaces with internal and external customers, foreign order administration, freight forwarders, customs officers and other functional areas to ensure coordination and logistics of shipment. Selects carrier/forwarder for shipment of products and prepares documents for freight forwarders.

What you’ll do

  • Experience in US Export compliance and Asia Regional compliance
  • Responsibilities include review of parts specifications, bills of materials(BOM), descriptions, and external web sites to categorize Lam Materials into categories that have been previously defined by Global Trade. These categories correspond to tariff classifications in countries where Lam does business
  • Reviewing individual parts & Harmonized Tariff Schedule(HTS) classification for different kind of Mechanical, Electrical and Electronics items (semiconductor Industry)
  • Designating a category to each respective part,
  • Engaging Foreign Trade on periodic review to align on categorizations, and
  • Alerting Foreign Trade of parts that do not conform to any existing designations
  • Foreign Trade will provide initial instruction on job expectations and ongoing feedback on how to interpret the categories for which Lam Materials will be assigned.
  • Import/Export Customs entry audit for all regions(US, Europe, Asia)
  • Knowledge on US Government regulations on all aspects of International Import/Export Trade
  • Knowledge on Free Trade Agreement and validate eligibilities (KORUS, USMCA, AKFTA etc)
  • Knowledge on US FTZ (Free Trade Zone) & Malaysia LMW process(Licensed Manufacturing Warehouse)
  • Sanctioned party screening

Who we’re looking for

  • Years of Experience: Minimum 6 years of Experience

    Job Experience : working Experience in HTS/ECCN Product Classification, GTS release, sanctioned party screening, Export/Import Auditing and global Trade compliance

    Educational: Typically requires a 6-8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and Certification in global trade/Trade Compliance/Logistics

Preferred qualifications

  • Technical knowledge of semiconductor or comparable industries, including familiarity with Bills of Materials
  • Familiarity with reading technical specifications, engineering drawing, datasheets
  • Detailed oriented, strong analytical skills, and agility to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.
  • Working knowledge and technical abilities with the following:
    • SAP-GTS (Global Trade Service)
    • MS office tools (Advanced Excel
    • Desired skills: Power Apps and Power BI

  • Note: Candidates should be comfortable working in shift based on business needs. Shift timings (S1 shift:6am to 3pm & S2 Shift: 3pm to 12pm

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

title: Information Security Engineer, Technical Lead
jobDescription:
Job Summary

As a Vulnerability Management Analyst at Lam Research, you will play a critical role in execution of Vulnerability Management Program. An ideal candidate will be a subject matter expert in the VM Lifecycle Process and Reporting; with an ability to self-start while supporting and improving the overall Vulnerability Management Program for Lam’s assets on-prem, or cloud-hosted. The candidate must possess good understanding of tools, techniques, and procedures that modern attackers use and have required understanding of security frameworks and methodologies such as NIST, OWASP 10, SANS TOP 25, MITRE ATT&CK. This role requires the ability to work with teams across different time zones, including in APAC, EMEA, and North America. As a Vulnerability Management Analyst, you will play a crucial role in ensuring information security compliance, mitigating risks, and driving overall security excellence within the organization.

Job Responsibilities

  • You will be responsible for managing and executing day to day operations of our vulnerability management tools – including ensuring overall tool health and compliance, scheduling and executing scans, compiling and distributing reports, and tracking findings through resolution. Further, you will be responsible for monitoring threat intelligence feeds and help detect 0-day vulnerabilities and coordinate appropriate and timely response.
  • Service ownership will include ongoing understanding of current solution-set and make recommendations on improvements, be that by vendor, capability, configuration, deployment, compliance, process, or other.
  • Tool ownership will include ensuring appropriate configuration of the tools, scan sensors placement and compliance, timely scan cadence, appropriate coverage, detecting and highlighting gaps (and propose recommendations to address them), etc.
  • Reporting findings to relevant stakeholders will range from regular cadence updates of scheduled scans to proactive critical 0-day related alerts, as well as adhoc scans as necessary.
  • Develop relationships with stakeholders both in management and across the business units to help ensure familiarity with processes, expectations from each, and smooth execution of resolutions when vulnerabilities are detected.
  • Classify and prioritize the risk of new vulnerabilities according to the specifics of our unique environment's risk level, mitigating factors, and assessment of the impacts of internal and external threats.
  • Participate in impact assessments to help define prioritization and proper monitoring coverage. Provide recommendations and technical guidance for the vulnerability management program. Validate scan results, research mitigation methods and retest findings. Demonstrate understanding of infrastructure/cloud vulnerability scanning and configuration.
  • Develop automation, orchestration, and scripting to reduce manual processes, improving overall efficiency while also enabling new capabilities to meet our rapidly changing needs.
  • Analyze requirements to develop and manage program metrics and performance through reporting. Produce detailed reports and present metrics to key stakeholders in the business.

Who we’re looking for

  • Experience with scanning tools such as Microsoft Defender, Tenable, Rapid7, Qualys, etc, and their configurations.
  • Prior experience in systems or network administration, or understanding of requirements of such roles, including enterprise configurations of these areas.
  • Certified in one of the security certifications like CEH/CISSP/OSCP.
  • Experience with data analytics with the ability to provide qualitative analysis and recommendations.
  • Ability to develop strong working relationships with a variety of other enabling teams.
  • Strong attention to detail, data accuracy, and data analysis.
  • Self-motivated and operates with a high sense of urgency and a high level of integrity.
  • Ability to automate technical tasks using API or scripting.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or 5+ years of Cybersecurity experience with a concentration in vulnerability management.
  • Understanding a variety of technical concepts such as Networking, Systems Administration, Application Development, and Information Security practices.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

title: Electrical Engineer 1
jobDescription:
The group you’ll be a part of

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.

The impact you’ll make

Join Lam as an Electrical Engineer and you'll be at the forefront, designing and developing electronic solutions for advanced applications. Your role involves designing and analyzing equipment, conducting experimental tests, evaluating results to create reliable cutting-edge solutions.

In this role, you will directly contribute to ___.

What you’ll do

  • Design and develop electronic parts, modules, and/or systems, applying engineering methods to design.
  • Contributes to research and development efforts by establishing operating data to improve electrical system designs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering design teams to design and modify custom and OEM system components.
  • Perform hands-on test and validation utilizing lab equipment to characterization of the performance of the electrical/ electro-mechanical systems.
  • Prepare high-quality reports and technical presentations to clearly communicate design intent, analysis, and results to diverse audiences in design reviews.

Who we’re looking for

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field with no previous professional experience; or equivalent work experience.
  • Hands-on experience in electronic circuit design (analog, digital), signal and controls theory, development and associated electrical board design, troubleshooting and validation.
  • Familiarity with CAD tools for circuit design and simulation (e.g., PCAD, ORCAD, ZUKEN, Auto CAD, Spice, ADS, HFSS).
  • This is a graduate eligible role.

Preferred qualifications

  • Knowledge in application of power and controls technologies for systems automation.
  • Familiar with design for serviceability, manufacturability, reliability.
  • Knowledge of troubleshooting systems with tools like network sniffers, protocol analyzers, and tool logs.

The group you'll be a part of In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry. The impact you'll make Join Lam as an Electrical Engineer and you'll be at the forefront, designing and developing electronic solutions for advanced applications. Your role involves designing and analyzing equipment, conducting experimental tests, evaluating results to create reliable cutting-edge solutions. In this role, you will directly contribute to ___. What you'll do Design and develop electronic parts, modules, and/or systems, applying engineering methods to design. Contributes to research and development efforts by establishing operating data to improve electrical system designs. Collaborate with cross-functional engineering design teams to design and modify custom and OEM system components. Perform hands-on test and validation utilizing lab equipment to characterization of the performance of the electrical/ electro-mechanical systems. Prepare high-quality reports and technical presentations to clearly communicate design intent, analysis, and results to diverse audiences in design reviews. Who we're looking for MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field with no previous professional experience; or equivalent work experience. Hands-on experience in electronic circuit design (analog, digital), signal and controls theory, development and associated electrical board design, troubleshooting and validation. Familiarity with CAD tools for circuit design and simulation (e.g., PCAD, ORCAD, ZUKEN, Auto CAD, Spice, ADS, HFSS). This is a graduate eligible role. Preferred qualifications Knowledge in application of power and controls technologies for systems automation. Familiar with design for serviceability, manufacturability, reliability. Knowledge of troubleshooting systems with tools like network sniffers, protocol analyzers, and tool logs. Oral and written communication skills including technical presentations. Our commitment We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results. Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees. Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories - On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. 'On-site Flex' you'll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. 'Virtual Flex' you'll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time. description:
The group you’ll be a part of

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.

The impact you’ll make

Join Lam as an Electrical Engineer and you'll be at the forefront, designing and developing electronic solutions for advanced applications. Your role involves designing and analyzing equipment, conducting experimental tests, evaluating results to create reliable cutting-edge solutions.

In this role, you will directly contribute to ___.

What you’ll do

  • Design and develop electronic parts, modules, and/or systems, applying engineering methods to design.
  • Contributes to research and development efforts by establishing operating data to improve electrical system designs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering design teams to design and modify custom and OEM system components.
  • Perform hands-on test and validation utilizing lab equipment to characterization of the performance of the electrical/ electro-mechanical systems.
  • Prepare high-quality reports and technical presentations to clearly communicate design intent, analysis, and results to diverse audiences in design reviews.

Who we’re looking for

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field with no previous professional experience; or equivalent work experience.
  • Hands-on experience in electronic circuit design (analog, digital), signal and controls theory, development and associated electrical board design, troubleshooting and validation.
  • Familiarity with CAD tools for circuit design and simulation (e.g., PCAD, ORCAD, ZUKEN, Auto CAD, Spice, ADS, HFSS).
  • This is a graduate eligible role.

Preferred qualifications

  • Knowledge in application of power and controls technologies for systems automation.
  • Familiar with design for serviceability, manufacturability, reliability.
  • Knowledge of troubleshooting systems with tools like network sniffers, protocol analyzers, and tool logs.
  • Oral and written communication skills including technical presentations.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

At Lam Research, we create equipment that drives technological advancements in the semiconductor industry. Our innovative solutions enable chipmakers to power progress in nearly all aspects of modern life, and it takes each member of our team to make it possible.


Across our organization, our employees come to work and change the world. We take on the toughest challenges with precision and accuracy. We push for the next big semiconductor breakthrough. We lead the way in one of the most critical and fast-moving industries on the planet. And we do it together, with deep connections and limitless collaboration.


The impact we have on the world is made possible by focusing on our people. So we recognize and celebrate our teams’ achievements. We strive to create an inclusive and diverse culture where everyone’s contribution and voice has value. title: Software Technical Lead Engineer
jobDescription:
The group you’ll be a part of

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.

The impact you’ll make

As a Software Engineer at Lam, you will be at the forefront of innovation by designing, developing, and troubleshooting, and debugging software programs. Your role is pivotal in developing software tools that support design, infrastructure, and technology platforms. Your expertise will determine hardware compatibility and influence design, ensuring seamless integration between software and hardware.

In this role, you’ll make an impact across Lam’s entire product portfolio of equipment working within our centralized software engineering team, collaborating with some of the brightest minds in the industry.

What you’ll do

  • Job Summary

    • Responsible for development and maintenance of control systems software for semiconductor wafer fab equipment’s manufactured by Lam.
    • Independently owns and drives complex projects involving HW device interfacing in all phases of software development.
    • Responsible for leading, mentoring and driving projects involving multiple developers from within and other departments by taking complete ownership of component or product software.
    • Interacts with cross functional teams across global regions to participate and contributes to technical discussions.
    • Provides quick response in handling critical issues reported by customers and product groups.

    Primary RESPONSIBILITIES:

    • Software requirement gathering, design, development, testing of projects for a chamber in wafer fabrication equipment involving multiple device interactions.
    • Responsible for defect fixing and maintenance of software install base by analysing, debugging, and fixing customer issues.
    • Analysis and troubleshooting of software and hardware communication issues, command/response implementation on serial, Ethernet, Ether CAT connectivity.
    • Actively contributes to technical reviews, guide junior engineers in design and implementation phases of product software.
    • Plans, co-ordinates, technical reviews multiple SW development activities (multi-tasking) in parallel to SW project development.
    • Applies past learnings and experiences to demonstrates abilities in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions based on customer and product groups business requirements.

Who we’re looking for

Preferred qualifications

Years of Experience: 5-7 Years

Mandatory Skills:

  • Exposure and experience in CFT to understand hardware specification, schematics and convert into Software requirements, design, and implementation.
  • Hands on experience of design and developing equipment/machine control software using object-oriented program.
  • Interested in semiconductor domain and keen to work in wafer-fabrication equipment software using Smalltalk programming language.
  • Strong understanding and experience in OOPS concepts
  • Strong analytical, logical, problem solving, trouble shooting skills.
  • Hands on experience in complete project development life cycle like waterfall, Agile, Kanban models etc.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.

Desirable Skills:

    • Experience in working on embedded systems.
    • Experience in programming in C/C++/C#/Python.
    • Hands on experience in software source control and bug tracking tools.
    • Hands on experience in RTOS.
    • Experience in the semiconductor equipment manufacturing industry.
    • Understanding of distributed systems.
    • Knowledge of equipment control framework like Control WORKS.
    • Hands on experience in programming using Visual Studio
    • Hands on experience in semiconductor Factory Automation
    • Exposure and experience with serial, MODBUS and Ether Cat protocol implementation between Software and Hardware controller communication.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

title: Technical Program Manager 3
jobDescription:
The group you’ll be a part of

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.

The impact you’ll make

As a Technical Program Manager at Lam, you are not just overseeing projects – you’re orchestrating breakthroughs in support of [insert strategic initiative]. You’ll lead cross-functional teams through successful project execution blending your technical excellence with strategic planning to deliver new or upgraded products. Your role is vital, owning technical projects from initiation through delivery using your expertise in planning, directing, and monitoring schedules and budget.

What you’ll do

  • Over-see the optimization or creation of technical product offerings, processes, or programs, developing project plans, aligning teams, managing risk, and driving projects through release.
  • Take ownership and accountability for the success of projects and cross-functional teams to ensure program schedules, performance metrics, and delivery meets business requirements on time and within budget.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand process and system requirements, and deliver enhancements based on a changing technology landscape.
  • Participate in Continuous Improvement projects from inception to impactful results.
  • Perform data collection and statistical analysis, and report results to inform program schedules and deliverables.
  • Influence cross-functional stakeholders to continuously improve the process and inspire alignment.
  • Deliver change management for programs that are sustainable and maintains long-term success.
  • Successfully navigate multiple projects in a dynamic environment.

Who we’re looking for

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of experience; or Master’s degree with 3+ years’ experience; or a Ph D with no previous professional experience; or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of continuous improvement or technical program management.
  • Experience guiding cross-functional teams and demonstrating influence skills to deliver results.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to present to audiences at all levels in the Company.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in or knowledge of Semiconductor fabrication, Semiconductor Equipment Operations, or related industries is a plus.
  • Knowledge of E&O processes, Change orders, repair/refurbishment processes.
  • Knowledge of Quality Problem solving 8D methodology.
  • Knowledge of Program Management methods and experience in Product Development & Release (PDR) procedures.
  • Relevant project management certifications such as PMP, CAPM, Scrum Master, or PRINCE2.
  • Experience in Lean Six Sigma methodology or certification (Green Belt, Black Belt) is a plus.
  • Experience with Agile and/or Waterfall project methodologies.
  • Familiarity with project management software and tools including MS Project, Quick Base, Office Timeline, or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of Change Management methodologies is a plus.

description:
The group you’ll be a part of

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.

The impact you’ll make

As a Technical Program Manager at Lam, you are not just overseeing projects – you’re orchestrating breakthroughs in support of [insert strategic initiative]. You’ll lead cross-functional teams through successful project execution blending your technical excellence with strategic planning to deliver new or upgraded products. Your role is vital, owning technical projects from initiation through delivery using your expertise in planning, directing, and monitoring schedules and budget.

What you’ll do

  • Over-see the optimization or creation of technical product offerings, processes, or programs, developing project plans, aligning teams, managing risk, and driving projects through release.
  • Take ownership and accountability for the success of projects and cross-functional teams to ensure program schedules, performance metrics, and delivery meets business requirements on time and within budget.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand process and system requirements, and deliver enhancements based on a changing technology landscape.
  • Participate in Continuous Improvement projects from inception to impactful results.
  • Perform data collection and statistical analysis, and report results to inform program schedules and deliverables.
  • Influence cross-functional stakeholders to continuously improve the process and inspire alignment.
  • Deliver change management for programs that are sustainable and maintains long-term success.
  • Successfully navigate multiple projects in a dynamic environment.

Who we’re looking for

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of experience; or Master’s degree with 3+ years’ experience; or a Ph D with no previous professional experience; or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of continuous improvement or technical program management.
  • Experience guiding cross-functional teams and demonstrating influence skills to deliver results.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to present to audiences at all levels in the Company.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in or knowledge of Semiconductor fabrication, Semiconductor Equipment Operations, or related industries is a plus.
  • Knowledge of E&O processes, Change orders, repair/refurbishment processes.
  • Knowledge of Quality Problem solving 8D methodology.
  • Knowledge of Program Management methods and experience in Product Development & Release (PDR) procedures.
  • Relevant project management certifications such as PMP, CAPM, Scrum Master, or PRINCE2.
  • Experience in Lean Six Sigma methodology or certification (Green Belt, Black Belt) is a plus.
  • Experience with Agile and/or Waterfall project methodologies.
  • Familiarity with project management software and tools including MS Project, Quick Base, Office Timeline, or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of Change Management methodologies is a plus.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

title: Electrical Manager
jobDescription:
The group you’ll be a part of

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's WETS products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry

Primary RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead, develop, and manage a group of 7-10 electrical, electronic/control engineers and subject matter experts at Lam India performing Product Development activities for Product Group
  • Responsible for the research, design, development, modification, and evaluation of our products & subsystems by complex decision-making considering cost concerns and technical risks
  • Responsible for determining and leading design approaches and analysing equipment to establish operating data, conduct experimental tests, and evaluate results
  • Performs resource management and reviews (Budgeting, Prioritization, procurement, Utilization, Forecasting, reporting etc) for the team
  • Act as advisor to unit or sub-units and may become actively involved, as required, to meet schedules and resolve problems.
  • Interacts with India and Europe based Mechanical, Electrical Engineers, managers of different Lam Product Groups in delivering results.
  • Can be responsible for creating management of best practices and documentation at departmental levels

Mandatory Skills:

  • Demonstrated experience with capital equipment or similar (for e.g. medical instrumentation, automotive, aircraft, etc.) industry in a sub-system design function. 6+ years of prior experience in managing direct reports consisting of electrical engineers / lead engineers/ Subject matter experts working on multiple projects
  • Proven hands-on experience in the design, control, and productization of complex equipment, machinery, and AC/DC power distribution
  • Proven hands-on experience in the design, development, and realization of control panel designs/PCBA/ electrical subsystems from concept to final release for mass volume production
  • Demonstrated leadership skills in decision making and problem solving in absence of complete or accurate data. Experience in situational leadership, conducting appraisal feedback and motivating team in achieving business results

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Masters in Electrical / Electronics engineering with 10 years of relevant experience or
  • Bachelors in Electrical / Electronics Engineering 12 years of relevant experience

Desirable Skills:

  • Experience in selection of components, setting up equipment for experimentation / testing in laboratory environment, setting up safe practices.
  • Awareness of standards and compliances like SEMI, NFPA, NEC, UL IEC, IEEE
  • Exposure to vendor development and concurrent engineering
  • Prior SEMI industry experience

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

title: Electrical Technical lead Engineer
jobDescription:
The group you’ll be a part of

The Global Operations Group brings information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high-volume manufacturing together to drive the engine of our global business operations. We help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam's business.

The impact you’ll make

Join Lam as an Electrical Engineer and you'll be at the forefront, designing and developing electronic solutions for advanced applications. Your role involves designing and analyzing equipment, conducting experimental tests, evaluating results to create reliable cutting-edge solutions.

In this role, you will directly contribute to ___.

What you’ll do

  • This position is for the Manufacturing Engineering Department at Lam India, Bangalore, and closely working with Pilot & HVME Manufacturing engineers, test engineers, industrial engineers across global build facilities.
  • Lead the development of electrical and electro-mechanical systems, including power distribution and control architecture for fixtures, outriggers, and test equipment
  • Own and drive successful design reviews to get buy-in from all cross-functional teams & stakeholders for new design concepts.
  • Provide technical leadership for sustaining engineering activities such as cable assy schematic and system interconnect schematics design, mistake-proofing of designs (e.g. poke-yoke of connectors, cables, etc.) and provide resolution to PRs.
  • Develops functional specifications for electrical/ electro-mechanical systems and power distribution components.
  • Ensure compliance with design standards, schedules, and KPIs for quality and on-time delivery.
  • Provide accurate and timely resolution to design related production issues encountered during the build process of fixtures, outriggers & test equipment.

Who we’re looking for

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s in Electrical & Electronics Eng., Electronics & Instrumentation Eng., Electronics and Communication Engineering with 5 to 8 years of relevant experience.
  • Proficient in system level understanding of Electro-Mechanical Sub-systems (Semi-conductor/Automotive/Aerospace), Power Distribution/Control systems and/or Industrial Automation.
  • Strong experience in electrical component selection for power distribution and control systems, including devices such as MCBs, MCCBs, ELCBs, RCBOs, relays, contactors, SMPS, PLC I/O modules (AI/AO, DI/DO), and industrial sensors used in automation environments.
